profile_description: Structured defense: GitHub free text is converted to schema-constrained evidence before scoring.

relevant_experience.evidence: The candidate has multiple years of experience as a Software Developer at Literacysoft, with achievements such as top category status in education and over 950k downloads between android and iOS app stores.

project_system_evidence.evidence: The candidate developed the popular mobile App 'Phonics and Reading with McGuffey' under their own initiative, which achieved top category status in education. They also have experience working on internal tools at PPG.

technical_skills_match.evidence: The candidate has a broad range of technical skills, including database management, mobile app development, programming languages (PHP, Javascript, Python, Java, C#), operating systems (MacOS X, Linux, Ubuntu, Debian, Raspbian), web development (HTML 5, CSS, Jquery, Ngnix), virtualization (Virtualization, Vmware), containerization (Docker), game development (Unity 3D), and scripting languages (Bash, ECMAScript, Adobe AIR).

evidence_quality_impact.evidence: The candidate has some responsibilities described in their work experience, but the detail is light and mostly task/support oriented.
